provenance: Flattened Consolidated Statements of Income and Consolidated Balance Sheets transcribed from The Coca-Cola Company's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2025-02-20). FY2024 Net Operating Revenues 47,061, Operating Income 9,992, Total Current Assets 25,997, and Total Current Liabilities 25,249 match the SEC HTML filing. Comparative columns are from the same statement pages and exercise year binding plus calendar-year consumer-staples layout (distinct from Apple/Alphabet/Microsoft technology filings).
